name: StoreCashier – Advanced POS & Inventory Management for WooCommerce
author: Software IT

sections.description:
StoreCashier is an advanced point of sale (POS) and inventory management plugin for WooCommerce. It combines a fast full-screen barcode POS register with an append-only stock ledger, IMEI / serial and lot / expiry tracking, purchases with landed cost, supplier and customer balances, sell and purchase returns, payment accounts, accounting, reports and an optional AI assistant with WooCommerce product description generation. Every POS sale is a real WooCommerce order, so your online shop and your counter share one product catalogue, one stock pool and one order history.

StoreCashier also runs the back office behind the counter, with suppliers, purchasing, customer balances and payment accounts. StoreCashier Pro adds expenses, advanced accounting, multiple stores, manufacturing, repair, CRM, HR and more. These workflows use connected WooCommerce and StoreCashier records.

  • Website and StoreCashier Pro
  • Documentation
  • Live demo – Username: admin, Password: admin
  • Support – open a ticket

Quick facts

  • Plugin type: WooCommerce barcode POS, inventory management, purchasing, supplier management, accounting and reporting.
  • Requires: WordPress 6.2+, PHP 7.4+ and WooCommerce 8.0+. Compatible with HPOS and Cart / Checkout blocks.
  • Free edition: barcode POS and inventory management for one business location, with no time limit.
  • Pro edition: separate commercial plugin; all free data is kept on upgrade. Free-edition screens of Pro modules are read-only previews marked PRO.
  • Core strengths: append-only stock ledger, IMEI / serial tracking, lot and expiry dates, landed cost, supplier and customer dues, payment accounts, automatic stock updates on returns, WooCommerce-native orders.
  • POS devices: modern desktop, laptop or tablet browsers, plus a mobile register layout (Pro).
  • Offline POS for Windows & Android (Pro): sell offline with the paired apps and sync automatically when reconnected.
  • Data and privacy: core POS and inventory work without the optional Software IT AI service. See External services for details.

Point of Sale (POS) for WooCommerce

A full-screen, touch-friendly POS register for any desktop, laptop or tablet browser.

  • Product grid or list view with category chips, brand filter, sorting and an “in stock” filter
  • Instant search by name, SKU, barcode or product ID, with barcode scanner support, optional auto-add on exact match and scan quantity
  • Fast local search: the web POS loads a compact product index into the browser and searches and scans locally, even with tens of thousands of products
  • Variation picker for variable products and stock badges with a configurable low-stock threshold
  • IMEI and serial number selection: pick, scan or type the exact unit
  • Line and order discounts (fixed or percentage) with a maximum discount for cashiers
  • Unit price editing controlled by a setting (managers only, every cashier or nobody)
  • WooCommerce taxes shown including or excluding tax; VAT / tax number printed on invoices
  • Walk-in default customer or a required customer; “New POS sale” opens the POS from a customer profile with that customer selected
  • Overselling setting, enforced in the register and again when the sale is saved
  • Payment methods: cash, card, bank transfer, mobile wallet, cheque and other, with quick-cash buttons and change due
  • Customer advance: apply a customer’s advance to a sale from the POS payment window
  • Every sale saved as a WooCommerce order with the payment posted to your payment account
  • 80 mm receipt or A4 invoice, optional auto-print and recent sales for reprinting
  • Register themes (light, dark or automatic) and optional sounds
  • Split payments across several methods and accounts (Pro)
  • Online payments at the counter through WooCommerce gateways, card reader integrations (Stripe Terminal, Square, SumUp, Adyen, Mollie, Viva.com, Helcim, Dojo, custom HTTP terminals) and payment links the customer pays from their own phone (Pro)
  • Hold and recall sales, multiple carts, drafts and printable quotations (Pro)
  • WooCommerce coupons, shipping charges and sale notes (Pro)
  • Cash register sessions with opening float, cash in / out, expected vs counted cash and closing report (Pro)
  • Credit sales within credit limits, cash rounding and a built-in calculator (Pro)
  • Full keyboard control (F1–F10 and Alt shortcuts), quick-add customer and a mobile layout (Pro)
  • Offline POS for Windows and Android: sell offline and sync automatically when reconnected, one seat per POS device (Pro, included in Pro + POS Apps and Business packages)

Products and Inventory Management

  • Append-only stock ledger: every purchase, sale, return, opening-stock entry and adjustment is a stock movement
  • WooCommerce stock changes are ledgered: quantities edited in the product editor, Quick Edit, Bulk Edit, CSV importer or REST API are booked as opening stock or adjustments with a note
  • Product stock history per product and variation: quantities in and out, current stock and stock value at cost
  • Products list with stock, purchase price, status and WooCommerce sync
  • StoreCashier fields in the WooCommerce product editor: unit, barcode, purchase price and IMEI / serial tracking
  • AI product description generator: write product descriptions, short descriptions and titles with AI from the product editor
  • “Hide from website – sell only in the POS” option: hide products from shop, search, blocks, Store API and sitemaps while keeping them in POS, stock and reports
  • Units of measure with larger units (1 Box = 12 Pieces) converted to the base unit
  • Barcode and SKU generator with your own prefixes and valid EAN-13, EAN-8 and UPC-A check digits
  • Barcode label printing: Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8 and UPC-A on several sheet sizes and continuous rolls
  • Opening stock on screen or by CSV import, with lot number, expiry date and IMEI / serial numbers
  • Sync all WooCommerce products links every product and variation to the ledger without counting stock twice
  • Bulk stock tools: enable or disable “manage stock” and sync all quantities to WooCommerce
  • Product search index (exact barcode / SKU, then prefix, then contains) for fast search on every screen
  • Low-stock alerts using the product alert quantity, WooCommerce low-stock amount or a store-wide threshold
  • Serial numbers on sell and purchase returns
  • Stock per business location and opening stock per location (Pro)
  • Stock transfers with pending, in-transit and received statuses (Pro)
  • Stock adjustments for damage, expiry, loss, theft and counts, with optional approval (Pro)
  • In-plugin product editor for every WooCommerce product type, attributes and variations with bulk actions (Pro)
  • StoreCashier columns in the WooCommerce CSV product importer and exporter (Pro)
  • Serial numbers on transfers, adjustments, manufacturing and repair parts (Pro)

Purchases and Suppliers

  • Purchases with supplier, reference, supplier invoice number, date and status (received, pending, ordered)
  • Line items with unit cost, quantity, lot number, expiry date, purchase tax, discount and larger-unit entry
  • Landed cost: shipping and additional expenses (customs, handling) are spread over lines; ledger, stock valuation and profit use the landed unit cost, and the product purchase price updates automatically
  • Pay now or later from a chosen account, with pay terms and due dates
  • Received purchases add stock automatically; editing or deleting adjusts stock
  • IMEI and serial numbers captured on purchase lines
  • Document attachments, printable purchase orders and barcode labels
  • Purchase returns (debit notes) with reasons, attachments, supplier refunds and printable notes; return limits are enforced and editing or deleting reverses stock
  • Supplier profiles with addresses, contact persons, bank accounts, groups and opening balance
  • Supplier balances, payment history and statements; payments applied to the oldest dues first
  • Shipping status, carrier and tracking number on purchases (Pro)

Customers and Contacts

  • Customer profiles with addresses, contact persons, groups, price groups, credit limit and opening balance
  • Advanced profile tabs: overview with 12-month chart, sales, payments, ledger with running balance and CSV / PDF, returns, quotations, products bought and credit
  • Balances that exclude drafts, quotations and cancelled sales, subtract returns and add refunds
  • Customer advances: payments applied to the oldest dues first; leftover kept as advance, usable on later invoices or refundable
  • Two-way sync with WooCommerce customers and WordPress users, created silently without e-mails
  • Bulk import of customers and suppliers from CSV, Excel or pasted data with mapping, validation and duplicate handling
  • Multi-word POS customer search and phone matching with or without spaces
  • Safe deletion: contacts with linked records cannot be deleted; set them to Inactive
  • Customer payment links: full or partial online payment split across dues (Pro)
  • Customer and supplier in one: net balance, combined ledger and settlement without cash movement (Pro)
  • Custom fields for contacts, products and other records (Pro)
  • Pro profile tabs: repairs, services, subscriptions, bookings, CRM, support, documents, communications, activity log, loyalty and ageing

Sales and Orders

  • All orders in one list (WooCommerce checkout and POS) with channel, status and date filters
  • Invoices and receipts with logo, business details, header / footer text and invoice number scheme
  • StoreCashier panel on the WooCommerce order screen, including IMEI / serial assignment
  • Automatic stock deduction at chosen order statuses; cancelled orders return stock
  • Cancelled paid sales for named customers turn the payment into a customer advance. Reopening reverses the advance. Walk-in refunds are handled manually
  • Packing slips, bulk status changes, bulk invoice printing and CSV export
  • Sell returns (credit notes) from any order or POS sale: restocking, refunds from a payment account, serials back in stock, quantity limits and WooCommerce refunds mirrored
  • Robust POS saving: a sale is saved completely even if another plugin fails while order e-mails are built
  • In-plugin order editor: items, fees, shipping, coupons, refunds, addresses and notes (Pro)
  • Order notifications by e-mail, SMS and WhatsApp with optional PDF invoice (Pro)

Accounting, Expenses and Finance

  • Payment accounts (cash, bank, card, mobile wallet) with opening balances and bank details
  • Account book with deposits, withdrawals and fund transfers
  • Default accounts and a “Link Account” tool for older payments, showing money in or out
  • Balance sheet and payment account report
  • Expenses and other income with categories, payees, tax, attachments and recurring entries (Pro)
  • Trial balance and cash flow statements (Pro)
  • Card reader accounts for card payments (Pro)
  • Database Backup and Restore with scheduled backups and optional Google Drive storage (Pro)

Multi Store, Warehouses and Branches

  • Free: one business location with full stock and sales
  • Pro: multiple shops, warehouses and branches with stock and opening stock per location
  • Pro: stock transfers, inter-branch stock requests with approval, branch profit and loss
  • Pro: staff and payment accounts scoped to locations

Manufacturing (Pro)

  • Multi-level bills of materials (BOM) with versions, by-products, scrap, labour and overhead
  • Production orders, work centers, routings, job cards, quality checks and production calendar
  • MRP and actual costing posted to the stock ledger
  • Reports for volume, yield, scrap, wastage, cost variance and work in progress

Reports and Analytics

  • Dashboard with KPI cards (sales, purchases, receivables, payables, stock value), charts, top products and customers, low-stock alerts
  • Profit / loss using purchase and landed cost; sales summary and payment method summary
  • Core reports: product purchases, product sales, items, stock, daily and monthly sales, and payment methods
  • IMEI / serial number report with full unit history
  • Financial-year ranges; tables are searchable, printable and exportable to CSV or Excel
  • 60 advanced reports (Pro): product profit, category and brand sales, trending products, tax, POS register, staff performance, stock valuation, low stock / reorder, expiry and lot, plus module reports
  • Report Builder (Pro): bar, line, pie, table or KPI widgets pinned to the dashboard

AI Assistant and AI Product Writer

Available in Free and Pro with administrator opt-in.

  • AI live chat assistant answers questions about sales, stock and dues using your store data with the user’s own permissions, links to the right screen and can hand over to the StoreCashier team
  • “Generate with AI” writes product titles, descriptions and short descriptions with tone, length, language, SEO and emoji options, with preview before inserting
  • Settings → AI Chat: connection status, role access, token wallet with free monthly allowance, optional token packs, and “Disconnect & delete my data”
  • Off by default until an administrator accepts the terms; nothing is sent before that

More Business Modules in StoreCashier Pro

All modules share the same customers, products and accounts, and can be switched on or off in the module manager.

  • Services: service jobs, catalog services and products on one job
  • Repair shop: job sheets with device, IMEI and checklist, estimates with online approval, parts from stock, warranty claims
  • CRM and leads: deal pipelines, proposals, contracts with e-signature, lead scoring, web-to-lead forms
  • HR and payroll: employees, attendance, leave, salary structures, payroll runs, PDF payslips, employee portal
  • Bookings: bookable products with availability rules, resources, deposits and admin calendar
  • Subscriptions: trials, automatic renewals, plan switching, MRR and churn reports
  • Support tickets: helpdesk with SLA, canned responses, knowledge base, customer portal
  • Projects and tasks: Kanban, Gantt, timesheets, invoicing of unbilled work
  • Fixed assets: register, check-out, maintenance, depreciation
  • Approvals, documents and audit trail: multi-step approvals, document library, field-level history
  • Mobile Plans & Activations: carrier plans, activations, renewals and commission tracking (every Pro package)

Integrations, Setup and Staff

  • WooCommerce native: HPOS and Cart / Checkout blocks, existing products, taxes, customers and orders
  • Safe start on existing stores: customer import, sales history without stock moves, opening stock sync
  • Quick Setup wizard: business, regional settings, location, inventory, POS, staff and optional AI
  • Settings for business, tax, products, contacts, orders, POS, invoices, barcodes and reference prefixes
  • Light and dark admin themes and searchable, exportable tables; translation-ready
  • POS staff: let selected WordPress users sell and limit their payment accounts
  • Custom roles with permission matrix and location scoping (Pro)
  • REST API, webhooks, Elementor widgets, shortcodes, My Account tabs (Pro)

Who StoreCashier is for

Retail shops, supermarkets, electronics and mobile phone shops (IMEI), pharmacies and grocery stores (lot and expiry), wholesalers, restaurants and cafés, WooCommerce stores adding a physical counter, and with Pro: multi-store chains, manufacturers, repair and service businesses.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: POS register, stock ledger, products, barcodes and labels, purchases and returns, IMEI / serial, orders, invoices, sell returns, customers, suppliers, payment accounts, balance sheet, core reports, POS staff, Quick Setup and AI assistant for one location.
  • Pro: everything marked (Pro) above, from advanced POS, offline apps and multi store to expenses, manufacturing, CRM, HRM, repair, bookings, subscriptions, REST API, Report Builder and 60 reports.

External services

StoreCashier AI assistant (optional, off by default)

StoreCashier can connect to the StoreCashier AI assistant service run by Software IT (softwareit.com.bd). It powers the optional AI chat inside StoreCashier (questions about your store and about StoreCashier, with an option to talk to the StoreCashier team), the “Generate with AI” product description button, and usage statistics. StoreCashier works fully without it and …
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install StoreCashier from Plugins → Add New (or upload the storecashier folder to /wp-content/plugins/) and activate it.
  3. Open Inventory Management in the WordPress admin menu and follow the Quick Setup wizard.
  4. Review your business, tax, invoice and POS settings (Settings → Orders & POS).
  5. Run Products → Opening Stock → Sync all WooCommerce products, or enter opening stock for your products, and add your payment accounts and suppliers.
  6. Open Sales & POS → POS to make your first counter sale.
sections.faq:
What is StoreCashier?

StoreCashier is an advanced point of sale (POS) and inventory management plugin for WooCommerce. The free edition covers the barcode POS register, an exact stock ledger, IMEI / serial and lot tracking, purchases, suppliers, customers, payment accounts, invoices, returns and core reports. StoreCashier Pro adds an advanced POS (split and online payments, cash register sessions, credit sales), multiple stores and warehouses, expenses, accounting statements and manufacturing, plus optional business modules such as CRM, HRM, bookings and subscriptions.

How is StoreCashier different from other WooCommerce POS plugins?

StoreCashier combines a WooCommerce checkout register with an append-only stock ledger, unit-level IMEI / serial tracking, lot numbers, expiry dates, purchases with landed cost, supplier and customer dues, and payment accounts. Sales returns add items back to stock, while purchase returns remove the items sent back to suppliers. StoreCashier Pro adds stock per location, transfers, stock adjustments, manufacturing, expenses and advanced accounting statements.

What makes the StoreCashier POS register advanced?

The register is built for busy counters: instant barcode search with auto-add, a variation picker, IMEI / serial selection, stock badges, line and order discounts with a cashier limit, controlled price editing, WooCommerce taxes, quick-cash buttons and change due, 80 mm receipts and A4 invoices. Every sale is a real WooCommerce order and its payment is posted to a payment account. StoreCashier Pro adds split payments, online payments through your WooCommerce gateways, payment links, hold and recall, multiple carts, quotations, coupons, cash register sessions with a closing report, credit sales, cash rounding, keyboard shortcuts and a mobile layout.

Can StoreCashier replace a separate inventory software?

For most shops, yes. StoreCashier keeps an append-only stock ledger with a movement for every purchase, sale, return and opening-stock entry, and syncs the result to WooCommerce. It handles units, barcodes and SKUs, label printing, IMEI / serial numbers, lot numbers and expiry dates, purchases with landed cost, supplier dues and purchase returns. StoreCashier Pro adds stock per location, transfers, stock adjustments with approval, stock valuation, low stock / reorder and expiry reports.

Is StoreCashier a good POS for a multi-store business?

Yes, with StoreCashier Pro. Each shop, warehouse or branch has its own stock and opening stock. Goods move between locations with stock transfers (pending, in transit, received) and inter-branch stock requests. Staff and payment accounts can be limited to their own location, and the Branches module compares profit and loss per branch. The free edition manages one business location.

Can I see stock value and profit per product?

Yes. The product stock history shows quantities in and out and stock value at cost, the dashboard shows total stock value, and the profit / loss report uses your purchase prices, including landed cost. StoreCashier Pro adds a product profit report, category and brand sales and a stock valuation report.

Is StoreCashier suitable for wholesale and distribution?

Yes. Purchases support supplier invoice numbers, lot numbers, landed cost, partial payments, pay terms and due dates. Customers have credit limits, opening balances, price groups and printable statements, and payments are applied to the oldest dues first. StoreCashier Pro adds credit sales at the POS, customer payment links for partial payments and multi-location stock.

What if a customer is also my supplier?

StoreCashier Pro can link a customer record and a supplier record for the same person or company. The profile then shows what they owe you, what you owe them and the net balance, with a combined ledger. A settlement offsets the receivable against the payable without any cash or bank movement, and deleting the settlement reverses both sides.

Can customers pay online for a sale or an old due?

Yes, with StoreCashier Pro. Sale and repair links collect the outstanding balance for that sale or job. A customer account link accepts the full balance or a partial payment through your WooCommerce payment gateways and applies it to the oldest unpaid invoices first.

Does StoreCashier require WooCommerce?

Yes. StoreCashier works with WooCommerce products, variations, orders, taxes and stock. Products and orders stay in WooCommerce; StoreCashier adds the stock ledger, payments, accounting and reports around them.

Does the POS create real WooCommerce orders?

Yes. Every POS sale is created as a WooCommerce order and flagged as a POS sale, so online and counter sales share the same products, stock and order history. The payment is recorded to the payment account you choose.

Which devices can run the POS?

The register runs in a modern browser on a desktop, laptop or tablet. It is a full-screen, touch-friendly screen, and it supports a light, dark or automatic theme. A mobile layout is included in StoreCashier Pro.

Does the POS work offline?

The browser register needs a connection to your WooCommerce site to complete a sale. The paired Windows and Android POS apps can save sales offline and sync automatically when the connection returns. The apps are included in the Pro + POS Apps and Business packages, with one POS device seat per device.

Can I use a barcode scanner?

Yes. Any scanner that types into the browser works. Scan into the POS search field or the purchase item search; products are matched by barcode, SKU, name or product ID. You can enable auto-add on an exact match and set the quantity added per scan.

Can I print receipts, invoices and barcode labels?

Yes. Receipts (80 mm) and A4 invoices use your logo, business details, header and footer text. Barcode labels can be printed in Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8 or UPC-A on several sheet sizes or continuous rolls, with name, price, SKU, variation, business name and packing date.

Can I generate SKUs and barcodes automatically?

Yes. The Barcode & SKU screen generates missing SKUs and barcodes in bulk with your own prefixes, and you can edit them on the same grid.

Can I sell products that are out of stock?

Yes, if you want to. The “Overselling” setting in Settings → Orders & POS is on by default. Turn it off to limit sales to the quantity available; the rule is checked in the register and again when the sale is saved.

Which payment methods does the POS support?

The free POS records one payment method per sale: cash, card, bank transfer, mobile wallet, cheque or other. Quick-cash buttons and the tendered amount calculate the change due, and the payment is posted to the payment account you choose. StoreCashier Pro adds split payments across several methods and accounts, credit sales within each customer’s credit limit and cash rounding.

What does StoreCashier Pro add to the POS?

Split payments, hold and recall, multiple carts, drafts and printable quotations, WooCommerce coupons, shipping charges, cash register sessions with opening float and closing report, a calculator, full keyboard shortcuts, quick-add customer, credit sales, cash rounding and a mobile layout.

Can cashiers change prices or give discounts?

You decide. A setting controls who may edit unit prices (managers only, every cashier or nobody), and a maximum discount for cashiers limits line and order discounts.

Can my staff use the POS without full admin access?

Yes. Turn on “POS Staff” for a WordPress user in Store Staff: they can use the register, view and add sales, view products and view or add customers. You can also limit the payment accounts each staff member may use. Custom roles with a full permission matrix and location scoping are part of StoreCashier Pro.

Does it track IMEI or serial numbers?

Yes. Enable tracking on a product, enter the numbers on purchases or opening stock (including the CSV import), and choose the exact unit when you sell it in the POS or on a WooCommerce order. Serials are printed on invoices and receipts, and the IMEI / Serial Number report shows the full history of every unit. Serials also come back in stock on sell returns and go out on purchase returns. StoreCashier Pro also tracks serials on transfers, adjustments, manufacturing and repair.

How does the stock ledger work?

Every purchase, sale and opening-stock entry is recorded as a stock movement. The product stock history shows quantities in and out, current stock and stock value at cost, and the total is synced back to WooCommerce.

Can I import opening stock?

Yes. Enter opening stock on screen or import a CSV with SKU, quantity, unit cost and optional lot number, expiry date and IMEI / serial numbers. “Sync all WooCommerce products” can also create opening stock from your current WooCommerce quantities.

Can I track lot numbers and expiry dates?

Yes. Purchases accept a lot number per line, and opening stock (on screen or by CSV) accepts a lot number and an expiry date. StoreCashier Pro adds lot and expiry reports, stock valuation and a low stock / reorder report.

What is landed cost on purchases?

Shipping charges and additional expenses (for example customs or handling) can be added to a purchase so the total reflects what the goods really cost you. Purchase prices are then used for stock value and profit reports.

How is stock deducted for online orders?

You choose the WooCommerce order statuses that deduct stock from the ledger. When an order reaches one of them, its items are deducted once; cancelled orders give the stock back. POS sales always deduct stock when the sale is saved.

How do purchases and supplier payments work?

Create a purchase with the supplier, items, unit costs, taxes, discount, shipping and additional expenses. A received purchase adds stock automatically. Pay in full, in part or later from a payment account; the purchases list shows what is paid and what is due.

How do customer and supplier balances work?

Each contact shows total sales or purchases, payments and balance due. A payment recorded on a contact is applied to the oldest due invoices first, and anything left over is kept as an advance. Printable statements are available for customers and suppliers.

Does StoreCashier include accounting?

The free edition includes payment accounts, an account book per account, deposits, withdrawals, fund transfers, a balance sheet and a payment account report. StoreCashier Pro adds expenses, income, trial balance and cash flow, and posts payroll, repairs and asset transactions to your accounts.

Do I need to set up payment accounts?

It is recommended. Add your cash drawer, bank, card and mobile wallet accounts with opening balances, then choose default accounts for money received or paid without a chosen account. A tool links older payments that have no account to the right one, and the account book shows every deposit, withdrawal, transfer and payment.

What reports are included?

The free edition includes the dashboard, profit / loss, daily / monthly sales summary, payment method summary, product purchase, product sell, items, stock and IMEI / serial reports. Every report table can be searched, printed and exported to CSV or Excel. StoreCashier Pro includes 60 built-in reports and a Report Builder.

Can I build my own reports?

StoreCashier Pro includes a Report Builder: choose a dataset (for example sales vs purchases, top products or sales by payment method), a chart type (bar, line, pie, table or KPI cards) and a date range, then pin the result to the dashboard. Each report shows only data the viewer is allowed to see.

How are taxes calculated?

StoreCashier uses the WooCommerce tax engine and your existing tax classes and rates. Prices in the POS cart are shown including or excluding tax according to your settings, and your VAT or tax registration number can be printed on invoices.

Can I customise invoices and receipts?

Yes. Add your logo and business details, header and footer text, choose the standard A4 or slim 80 mm layout and set the invoice number scheme. Reference prefixes for purchases, payments and other documents are configurable in Settings.

What does the Quick Setup wizard configure?

It walks you through business details, regional settings (currency, number format and time zone), your business location, inventory behaviour, POS options and staff. Every step writes to the same settings you can change later on the Settings screens, and you can re-run it at any time.

Are currency and time zone synced with WooCommerce and WordPress?

Yes. The currency and number format in StoreCashier are synced with WooCommerce, and the time zone is synced with WordPress, so you only set them once.

I already have a WooCommerce store. Is it safe to install?

Yes. StoreCashier mirrors your existing products and can import existing customers and sales history without creating duplicate stock movements. Your WooCommerce data is not removed.

Are customers synced with WooCommerce and WordPress?

Yes. Customers and suppliers are linked two-way with WooCommerce customers and WordPress users. Users are created silently, so no e-mails are sent to your customers.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. StoreCashier declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and the Cart and Checkout blocks, and uses the WooCommerce order APIs.

Is there a dark mode?

Yes. The StoreCashier admin screens have light and dark themes, and the POS register has its own light, dark or automatic theme.

Which businesses use StoreCashier?

StoreCashier is designed for retail shops, supermarkets, electronics and mobile phone shops, pharmacies, grocery stores, wholesalers, restaurants and cafés in the free edition. With StoreCashier Pro it also fits repair shops, salons, clinics, rentals, hotels, agencies, subscription businesses and manufacturers.

Can I switch off modules I do not need?

In StoreCashier Pro, the module manager (Settings → Modules) switches optional modules on or off. A disabled module disappears from menus, the REST API, My Account and widgets, but its data is kept.

Does StoreCashier include CRM, HRM or payroll?

Yes, in StoreCashier Pro. The CRM covers deal pipelines, proposals, estimates, contracts and leads. HRM and payroll cover employees, attendance, leave, salary structures, payroll runs with PDF payslips and an employee portal. In the free plugin these screens are visible as previews.

Can I sell bookings, appointments or subscriptions?

Yes, with StoreCashier Pro. It adds bookable products (appointments, rentals, classes and stays) and subscription products with trials, renewals and plan switching, both as WooCommerce product types with My Account tabs.

Is StoreCashier suitable for repair shops and manufacturers?

Yes, with StoreCashier Pro. Repair management covers job sheets, estimates with customer approval, parts from stock and warranty claims. Manufacturing covers multi-level bills of materials, production orders, job cards, quality checks and MRP.

Can customers manage their own bookings, subscriptions and tickets?

Yes, with StoreCashier Pro. It adds WooCommerce My Account tabs for subscriptions (pause, resume, cancel, switch plan, renew early), bookings (pay, cancel within your rules, calendar files), projects, support tickets and an employee HR portal. Each tab can be turned off in its module settings.

How does payroll work in StoreCashier Pro?

Define salary components and structures, then run payroll per month, branch or department. Payroll runs handle pro-ration, overtime, sales commission, unpaid leave, provident fund, social security, income-tax slabs and loan installments. Approved payroll can be posted to a payment account, and payslips can be printed, downloaded as PDF or e-mailed.

Can I manage fixed assets and depreciation?

Yes, with StoreCashier Pro. The asset register tracks custody check-out and check-in, transfers, maintenance schedules and logs, and calculates straight-line, declining-balance or units-of-production depreciation. Disposals record proceeds and gain or loss, and QR code or barcode labels can be printed.

Does StoreCashier Pro include approvals and an audit trail?

Yes. Approval workflows can hold stock adjustments, inter-branch stock requests, production completion, leave requests and custom requests until they are approved, with sequential or parallel steps, delegation and escalation. The audit trail records every create, update and delete with field-level before and after values, plus logins and settings changes.

Does StoreCashier Pro send e-mail, SMS or WhatsApp notifications?

StoreCashier Pro can notify customers about new orders and status changes by e-mail (WordPress mail or SMTP), SMS and WhatsApp, optionally with a PDF invoice. It contacts a messaging provider only after an administrator enables and configures one.

Is there a REST API?

Yes, in StoreCashier Pro: scoped API keys, endpoints for every module, HMAC-signed webhooks, request logs, rate limits and an interactive developer portal with OpenAPI and Postman export.

Do I need Elementor?

No. Elementor is optional and only used for the StoreCashier Pro widgets; the booking and subscription widgets have shortcode equivalents.

What happens if I upgrade to StoreCashier Pro?

StoreCashier Pro is a separate plugin. Activating it deactivates the free edition and continues with the same StoreCashier tables and settings, so all data is kept. If you later go back to the free edition, your data is still there.

What are the screens marked PRO?

They are read-only previews of StoreCashier Pro modules, so you can see how each one looks and works before deciding to upgrade. You can open and browse them, but saving or processing is only available in StoreCashier Pro. They never change your data.

Is there a demo?

Yes. The live demo at softwareit.com.bd/storecashier/demo/wp-admin (username admin, password admin) shows StoreCashier with sample data.

Does StoreCashier send any data to external services?

The core POS and inventory features work without the Software IT AI service. An administrator can opt in to that service for AI chat and product descriptions. See External services for the data that is sent, when it is sent, and how to disconnect. The chat scripts and styles are bundled with the plugin, and barcodes are generated locally.

Is my data removed when I deactivate or delete the plugin?

Deactivation never removes data. When the plugin is deleted, StoreCashier tables are removed only if you enabled “Delete all StoreCashier data when the plugin is deleted” in Settings → Business & General, and never while StoreCashier Pro is installed on the site. WooCommerce products and orders are never touched.

Where are the Leads, Expenses and Income screens?

In version 1.3.0 these workflows moved to StoreCashier Pro. They are still listed in the navigation as previews, and records you created with earlier versions stay in your database and are shown there. Editing them again requires StoreCashier Pro.

Is StoreCashier translation-ready?

Yes. All strings use the storecashier text domain and can be translated on translate.wordpress.org or with a translation plugin.

How do I get StoreCashier Pro?

Visit softwareit.com.bd/storecashier/ to learn more and purchase. Install StoreCashier Pro like any other plugin; it takes over from the free edition and keeps all your data.

Where can I get help?

Read the documentation at softwareit.com.bd/storecashier/doc/ or open a ticket at softwareit.com.bd/support/. Please include your WordPress, WooCommerce, PHP and StoreCashier versions and the steps to reproduce the issue.
sections.changelog:
1.6.10

  • Tweak: Refine the sidebar menu with clearer sections, highlighted active items and consistent submenu styling in light and dark mode.

1.6.9

  • Fix: Click a sidebar menu group to expand or collapse its submenu. Submenu links open their pages, and groups support keyboard activation.

1.6.8

  • New: AI assistant answers show tables, code, nested lists, task lists and quotes properly; wide tables scroll inside the chat. The product writer waits and continues by itself when the AI is busy.
  • New: Use a customer’s advance on an invoice from the sale’s payment screen, the customer’s Pay screen or the POS payment window. No new money enters any account, and deleting the applied payment gives the advance back.
  • Fix: Trashing a cancelled sale keeps the customer’s advance, the money and the stock; restoring it changes nothing. Deleting it for good leaves the money as the customer’s advance.
  • Fix: Cancelling a sale after a goods return only puts back the units the customer still had, and reopening it takes out only those again.
  • New: Cancelling a paid sale keeps the money in the payment account and turns it into the customer’s advance, which can be used on a later sale or refunded from the customer’s Pay screen; reopening the order reverses it exactly. Walk-in sales show staff that the refund must be given by hand.

  • Fixed: Accounting audit: sell returns now credit what the customer paid (tax and the share of the order discount included) and can never exceed the quantity sold; orders restored from the trash get their payments and stock back; a later purchase price no longer changes old profit; money paid on a deleted bill stays with the contact as an advance; three-decimal currencies keep their last digit; AI chat conversations are private to the user who started them.

  • Changed: The card about the StoreCashier Pro POS apps for Windows and Android now shows the apps on a computer and phone, says clearly that they need a Pro package and links to the plans. It appears on the dashboard (and stays closed once hidden), on the Settings → POS Apps preview and behind a “POS apps” button in the POS toolbar.

  • New: AI product writer with instructions, description styles, long designed descriptions, emoji and SEO options, plus a short description and product title. When AI tokens run out, a button leads to the top-up section of Settings → AI Chat.
  • New: Optional StoreCashier AI assistant – a chat button on StoreCashier screens (not over the POS register) that answers questions about your sales, stock and dues using your store data (read with the user’s own permissions), links to the right screen, and can hand the conversation to the StoreCashier team. Off until an administrator accepts its terms (new optional Quick Setup step, the chat panel or Settings → AI Chat); asked again after each update. Long conversations load page by page so they never slow the browser down.
  • New: Settings → AI Chat – connection status, turn the chat on or off, choose which roles may use it, AI token wallet (free monthly allowance, bonus and purchased tokens, history), optional token packs and offers, and “Disconnect & delete my data”.
  • New: “Generate with AI” in the product editor (StoreCashier and WooCommerce) writes a product description and short description in the tone, length and language you choose; preview before inserting.
  • New: Optional deactivation feedback on the Plugins screen – shown only when the AI assistant terms were accepted; “Skip & deactivate” sends no answer.
  • Privacy: See the new “External services” section for exactly what the optional AI assistant sends and when. Nothing is sent without an administrator’s consent.
  • New: The StoreCashier dashboard shows administrators a small card about the StoreCashier Pro POS apps for Windows and Android (offline selling). It can be closed and then stays hidden.
  • Fix: A product could show a quantity in the POS that is not in its stock history. WooCommerce 10.6+ pre-fills an empty “Quantity” field with 1, so saving a product for any other reason (e.g. a rename) stored a phantom 1 in stock. The empty quantity now defaults to 0.
  • Changed: The POS Apps preview lists the new Pro app update and app receipt settings as locked PRO actions.
  • Fix: Stock entered or changed in the WooCommerce product editor, variation editor, Quick Edit, Bulk Edit or the WooCommerce REST API is now booked in the StoreCashier stock ledger with a visible move (opening stock when the item had no movements, otherwise an adjustment with a note). Before, these quantities bypassed the ledger.
  • Fix: Every screen now uses the POS stock rule (ledger quantity once a product has movements, else the WooCommerce quantity): product search, purchase / transfer / adjustment search and the Products list (flagged with * and a hint). The stock history explains a WooCommerce quantity that is not in the ledger yet and offers “Record as opening stock” / “Reset WooCommerce quantity to 0”; movement notes are shown.
  • Performance: New product search index (table sc_search_index, built in the background, rebuilt from Products → Import & sync → “Rebuild search index”). Every product search box searches it (exact barcode / SKU first, then prefix, then contains) instead of LIKE joins on wp_postmeta, and result rows are built with batched queries — fast with tens of thousands of products. Index on sc_variations.wc_variation_id.
  • Performance: The web POS loads a compact product index into the browser (paged, gzip, cached in IndexedDB, refreshed with deltas every minute and after each sale) and searches / scans locally like the POS apps; the server search is used until it is loaded. Other search boxes cancel stale requests and reuse recent answers.
  • Fix: Accounting → Link Account posted a supplier advance (a payment to a supplier with no purchase attached) as money in. Linking now posts money out for purchase / expense payments, refunds to customers and supplier advances, and money in for sales, income, supplier refunds and customer advances; the screen shows the direction of every payment.
  • Fix: Editing a purchase payment reset its payment method to Cash. The edit form now has a Payment Method field and keeps the stored method and account (editing a sale or contact payment also keeps the stored method); the payments list shows the method.
  • Fix: Several purchase returns against one purchase could together return more than was received, and a purchase that was never received could be returned (taking stock that was never added). Returns now accept at most the received quantity minus what earlier returns took back (also when a return is edited), are refused with a clear message for ordered / pending purchases, and new returns are linked to their exact purchase.
  • Fix: Ordered and Pending purchases counted in the supplier’s balance due. Only received purchases are now owed (contact balance, pay-screen allocation, profile, statement, Supplier report, Purchase Due); money paid on an ordered / pending purchase counts as a supplier advance until it is received. Existing records are not changed.
  • New: Landed cost — shipping charges and additional expenses of a purchase are spread over its lines by line value; the stock ledger and stock valuation use the landed unit cost, and receiving a purchase updates the product / variation purchase price to it (Settings → Product → “Update product purchase price from received purchases”, on by default; logged in the activity log). A back-dated purchase never overwrites a newer price.
  • New: Optional expiry date per purchase line; it flows into the stock ledger, the Expiry report, the Lot report and purchase returns.
  • New: Purchase lines can be entered in a larger unit defined on the product’s unit (e.g. 1 Box = 12 Pieces): quantity and cost are converted to the base unit for stock and the ledger shows the conversion.
  • Fix: The Low Stock report and the dashboard low-stock tile / list now use the same rule: the product’s alert quantity, else the WooCommerce product low-stock amount, else the store-wide threshold.
  • Fix: The Sell Return prefix setting was ignored (returns were always CN…). New returns use the configured prefix; existing numbers are unchanged. Payments entered without a reference get the next Payment-prefix number and a business location saved without a code gets the Business Location prefix + id.
  • Fix: Purchase, purchase-return and sell-return numbers continue from the highest number already used (a deleted document could make the next one repeat a number).
  • Fix: The Barcode & SKU generator now creates valid EAN-13 / EAN-8 / UPC-A codes (configurable prefix + check digit) for items using those barcode types; Code 128 / Code 39 keep prefix + number. Help texts corrected.
  • Fix: The “Labels” links of products and purchases now pre-fill the Print Labels screen with the product (or every variation) or the purchase lines and their quantities.
  • Fix: The POS Register Report could show two “Cash” columns (payment methods stored as cash / Cash or with the same label); methods are merged and every column has a distinct label.

Both are read-only previews marked PRO.

Tick it in the StoreCashier box of the WooCommerce product editor, the Products list Actions menu or the WooCommerce Products bulk actions (“Hide from website (POS only)” / “Show on website”). Hidden products (and their variations) disappear from the shop, categories, search, widgets, blocks, shortcodes, related / upsell / cross-sell lists, the Store API and sitemaps (WordPress, Yoast, Rank Math); their page returns 404 for visitors (staff see a preview notice) and they cannot be added to a cart online. 1.6.4

  • Fix: Products with very long names (over 191 characters) were never linked to the stock ledger, so they appeared in product search on Add Purchase, transfers and adjustments but could not be added. short_description: Advanced WooCommerce POS and inventory management: barcode POS, stock ledger, IMEI/serial, purchases, suppliers, customers, accounts and reports.
description:
StoreCashier is an advanced point of sale (POS) and inventory management plugin for WooCommerce. It combines a fast full-screen barcode POS register with an append-only stock ledger, IMEI / serial and lot / expiry tracking, purchases with landed cost, supplier and customer balances, sell and purchase returns, payment accounts, accounting, reports and an optional AI assistant with WooCommerce product description generation. Every POS sale is a real WooCommerce order, so your online shop and your counter share one product catalogue, one stock pool and one order history.

StoreCashier also runs the back office behind the counter, with suppliers, purchasing, customer balances and payment accounts. StoreCashier Pro adds expenses, advanced accounting, multiple stores, manufacturing, repair, CRM, HR and more. These workflows use connected WooCommerce and StoreCashier records.

  • Website and StoreCashier Pro
  • Documentation
  • Live demo – Username: admin, Password: admin
  • Support – open a ticket

Quick facts

  • Plugin type: WooCommerce barcode POS, inventory management, purchasing, supplier management, accounting and reporting.
  • Requires: WordPress 6.2+, PHP 7.4+ and WooCommerce 8.0+. Compatible with HPOS and Cart / Checkout blocks.
  • Free edition: barcode POS and inventory management for one business location, with no time limit.
  • Pro edition: separate commercial plugin; all free data is kept on upgrade. Free-edition screens of Pro modules are read-only previews marked PRO.
  • Core strengths: append-only stock ledger, IMEI / serial tracking, lot and expiry dates, landed cost, supplier and customer dues, payment accounts, automatic stock updates on returns, WooCommerce-native orders.
  • POS devices: modern desktop, laptop or tablet browsers, plus a mobile register layout (Pro).
  • Offline POS for Windows & Android (Pro): sell offline with the paired apps and sync automatically when reconnected.
  • Data and privacy: core POS and inventory work without the optional Software IT AI service. See External services for details.

Point of Sale (POS) for WooCommerce

A full-screen, touch-friendly POS register for any desktop, laptop or tablet browser.

  • Product grid or list view with category chips, brand filter, sorting and an “in stock” filter
  • Instant search by name, SKU, barcode or product ID, with barcode scanner support, optional auto-add on exact match and scan quantity
  • Fast local search: the web POS loads a compact product index into the browser and searches and scans locally, even with tens of thousands of products
  • Variation picker for variable products and stock badges with a configurable low-stock threshold
  • IMEI and serial number selection: pick, scan or type the exact unit
  • Line and order discounts (fixed or percentage) with a maximum discount for cashiers
  • Unit price editing controlled by a setting (managers only, every cashier or nobody)
  • WooCommerce taxes shown including or excluding tax; VAT / tax number printed on invoices
  • Walk-in default customer or a required customer; “New POS sale” opens the POS from a customer profile with that customer selected
  • Overselling setting, enforced in the register and again when the sale is saved
  • Payment methods: cash, card, bank transfer, mobile wallet, cheque and other, with quick-cash buttons and change due
  • Customer advance: apply a customer’s advance to a sale from the POS payment window
  • Every sale saved as a WooCommerce order with the payment posted to your payment account
  • 80 mm receipt or A4 invoice, optional auto-print and recent sales for reprinting
  • Register themes (light, dark or automatic) and optional sounds
  • Split payments across several methods and accounts (Pro)
  • Online payments at the counter through WooCommerce gateways, card reader integrations (Stripe Terminal, Square, SumUp, Adyen, Mollie, Viva.com, Helcim, Dojo, custom HTTP terminals) and payment links the customer pays from their own phone (Pro)
  • Hold and recall sales, multiple carts, drafts and printable quotations (Pro)
  • WooCommerce coupons, shipping charges and sale notes (Pro)
  • Cash register sessions with opening float, cash in / out, expected vs counted cash and closing report (Pro)
  • Credit sales within credit limits, cash rounding and a built-in calculator (Pro)
  • Full keyboard control (F1–F10 and Alt shortcuts), quick-add customer and a mobile layout (Pro)
  • Offline POS for Windows and Android: sell offline and sync automatically when reconnected, one seat per POS device (Pro, included in Pro + POS Apps and Business packages)

Products and Inventory Management

  • Append-only stock ledger: every purchase, sale, return, opening-stock entry and adjustment is a stock movement
  • WooCommerce stock changes are ledgered: quantities edited in the product editor, Quick Edit, Bulk Edit, CSV importer or REST API are booked as opening stock or adjustments with a note
  • Product stock history per product and variation: quantities in and out, current stock and stock value at cost
  • Products list with stock, purchase price, status and WooCommerce sync
  • StoreCashier fields in the WooCommerce product editor: unit, barcode, purchase price and IMEI / serial tracking
  • AI product description generator: write product descriptions, short descriptions and titles with AI from the product editor
  • “Hide from website – sell only in the POS” option: hide products from shop, search, blocks, Store API and sitemaps while keeping them in POS, stock and reports
  • Units of measure with larger units (1 Box = 12 Pieces) converted to the base unit
  • Barcode and SKU generator with your own prefixes and valid EAN-13, EAN-8 and UPC-A check digits
  • Barcode label printing: Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8 and UPC-A on several sheet sizes and continuous rolls
  • Opening stock on screen or by CSV import, with lot number, expiry date and IMEI / serial numbers
  • Sync all WooCommerce products links every product and variation to the ledger without counting stock twice
  • Bulk stock tools: enable or disable “manage stock” and sync all quantities to WooCommerce
  • Product search index (exact barcode / SKU, then prefix, then contains) for fast search on every screen
  • Low-stock alerts using the product alert quantity, WooCommerce low-stock amount or a store-wide threshold
  • Serial numbers on sell and purchase returns
  • Stock per business location and opening stock per location (Pro)
  • Stock transfers with pending, in-transit and received statuses (Pro)
  • Stock adjustments for damage, expiry, loss, theft and counts, with optional approval (Pro)
  • In-plugin product editor for every WooCommerce product type, attributes and variations with bulk actions (Pro)
  • StoreCashier columns in the WooCommerce CSV product importer and exporter (Pro)
  • Serial numbers on transfers, adjustments, manufacturing and repair parts (Pro)

Purchases and Suppliers

  • Purchases with supplier, reference, supplier invoice number, date and status (received, pending, ordered)
  • Line items with unit cost, quantity, lot number, expiry date, purchase tax, discount and larger-unit entry
  • Landed cost: shipping and additional expenses (customs, handling) are spread over lines; ledger, stock valuation and profit use the landed unit cost, and the product purchase price updates automatically
  • Pay now or later from a chosen account, with pay terms and due dates
  • Received purchases add stock automatically; editing or deleting adjusts stock
  • IMEI and serial numbers captured on purchase lines
  • Document attachments, printable purchase orders and barcode labels
  • Purchase returns (debit notes) with reasons, attachments, supplier refunds and printable notes; return limits are enforced and editing or deleting reverses stock
  • Supplier profiles with addresses, contact persons, bank accounts, groups and opening balance
  • Supplier balances, payment history and statements; payments applied to the oldest dues first
  • Shipping status, carrier and tracking number on purchases (Pro)

Customers and Contacts

  • Customer profiles with addresses, contact persons, groups, price groups, credit limit and opening balance
  • Advanced profile tabs: overview with 12-month chart, sales, payments, ledger with running balance and CSV / PDF, returns, quotations, products bought and credit
  • Balances that exclude drafts, quotations and cancelled sales, subtract returns and add refunds
  • Customer advances: payments applied to the oldest dues first; leftover kept as advance, usable on later invoices or refundable
  • Two-way sync with WooCommerce customers and WordPress users, created silently without e-mails
  • Bulk import of customers and suppliers from CSV, Excel or pasted data with mapping, validation and duplicate handling
  • Multi-word POS customer search and phone matching with or without spaces
  • Safe deletion: contacts with linked records cannot be deleted; set them to Inactive
  • Customer payment links: full or partial online payment split across dues (Pro)
  • Customer and supplier in one: net balance, combined ledger and settlement without cash movement (Pro)
  • Custom fields for contacts, products and other records (Pro)
  • Pro profile tabs: repairs, services, subscriptions, bookings, CRM, support, documents, communications, activity log, loyalty and ageing

Sales and Orders

  • All orders in one list (WooCommerce checkout and POS) with channel, status and date filters
  • Invoices and receipts with logo, business details, header / footer text and invoice number scheme
  • StoreCashier panel on the WooCommerce order screen, including IMEI / serial assignment
  • Automatic stock deduction at chosen order statuses; cancelled orders return stock
  • Cancelled paid sales for named customers turn the payment into a customer advance. Reopening reverses the advance. Walk-in refunds are handled manually
  • Packing slips, bulk status changes, bulk invoice printing and CSV export
  • Sell returns (credit notes) from any order or POS sale: restocking, refunds from a payment account, serials back in stock, quantity limits and WooCommerce refunds mirrored
  • Robust POS saving: a sale is saved completely even if another plugin fails while order e-mails are built
  • In-plugin order editor: items, fees, shipping, coupons, refunds, addresses and notes (Pro)
  • Order notifications by e-mail, SMS and WhatsApp with optional PDF invoice (Pro)

Accounting, Expenses and Finance

  • Payment accounts (cash, bank, card, mobile wallet) with opening balances and bank details
  • Account book with deposits, withdrawals and fund transfers
  • Default accounts and a “Link Account” tool for older payments, showing money in or out
  • Balance sheet and payment account report
  • Expenses and other income with categories, payees, tax, attachments and recurring entries (Pro)
  • Trial balance and cash flow statements (Pro)
  • Card reader accounts for card payments (Pro)
  • Database Backup and Restore with scheduled backups and optional Google Drive storage (Pro)

Multi Store, Warehouses and Branches

  • Free: one business location with full stock and sales
  • Pro: multiple shops, warehouses and branches with stock and opening stock per location
  • Pro: stock transfers, inter-branch stock requests with approval, branch profit and loss
  • Pro: staff and payment accounts scoped to locations

Manufacturing (Pro)

  • Multi-level bills of materials (BOM) with versions, by-products, scrap, labour and overhead
  • Production orders, work centers, routings, job cards, quality checks and production calendar
  • MRP and actual costing posted to the stock ledger
  • Reports for volume, yield, scrap, wastage, cost variance and work in progress

Reports and Analytics

  • Dashboard with KPI cards (sales, purchases, receivables, payables, stock value), charts, top products and customers, low-stock alerts
  • Profit / loss using purchase and landed cost; sales summary and payment method summary
  • Core reports: product purchases, product sales, items, stock, daily and monthly sales, and payment methods
  • IMEI / serial number report with full unit history
  • Financial-year ranges; tables are searchable, printable and exportable to CSV or Excel
  • 60 advanced reports (Pro): product profit, category and brand sales, trending products, tax, POS register, staff performance, stock valuation, low stock / reorder, expiry and lot, plus module reports
  • Report Builder (Pro): bar, line, pie, table or KPI widgets pinned to the dashboard

AI Assistant and AI Product Writer

Available in Free and Pro with administrator opt-in.

  • AI live chat assistant answers questions about sales, stock and dues using your store data with the user’s own permissions, links to the right screen and can hand over to the StoreCashier team
  • “Generate with AI” writes product titles, descriptions and short descriptions with tone, length, language, SEO and emoji options, with preview before inserting
  • Settings → AI Chat: connection status, role access, token wallet with free monthly allowance, optional token packs, and “Disconnect & delete my data”
  • Off by default until an administrator accepts the terms; nothing is sent before that

More Business Modules in StoreCashier Pro

All modules share the same customers, products and accounts, and can be switched on or off in the module manager.

  • Services: service jobs, catalog services and products on one job
  • Repair shop: job sheets with device, IMEI and checklist, estimates with online approval, parts from stock, warranty claims
  • CRM and leads: deal pipelines, proposals, contracts with e-signature, lead scoring, web-to-lead forms
  • HR and payroll: employees, attendance, leave, salary structures, payroll runs, PDF payslips, employee portal
  • Bookings: bookable products with availability rules, resources, deposits and admin calendar
  • Subscriptions: trials, automatic renewals, plan switching, MRR and churn reports
  • Support tickets: helpdesk with SLA, canned responses, knowledge base, customer portal
  • Projects and tasks: Kanban, Gantt, timesheets, invoicing of unbilled work
  • Fixed assets: register, check-out, maintenance, depreciation
  • Approvals, documents and audit trail: multi-step approvals, document library, field-level history
  • Mobile Plans & Activations: carrier plans, activations, renewals and commission tracking (every Pro package)

Integrations, Setup and Staff

  • WooCommerce native: HPOS and Cart / Checkout blocks, existing products, taxes, customers and orders
  • Safe start on existing stores: customer import, sales history without stock moves, opening stock sync
  • Quick Setup wizard: business, regional settings, location, inventory, POS, staff and optional AI
  • Settings for business, tax, products, contacts, orders, POS, invoices, barcodes and reference prefixes
  • Light and dark admin themes and searchable, exportable tables; translation-ready
  • POS staff: let selected WordPress users sell and limit their payment accounts
  • Custom roles with permission matrix and location scoping (Pro)
  • REST API, webhooks, Elementor widgets, shortcodes, My Account tabs (Pro)

Who StoreCashier is for

Retail shops, supermarkets, electronics and mobile phone shops (IMEI), pharmacies and grocery stores (lot and expiry), wholesalers, restaurants and cafés, WooCommerce stores adding a physical counter, and with Pro: multi-store chains, manufacturers, repair and service businesses.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: POS register, stock ledger, products, barcodes and labels, purchases and returns, IMEI / serial, orders, invoices, sell returns, customers, suppliers, payment accounts, balance sheet, core reports, POS staff, Quick Setup and AI assistant for one location.
  • Pro: everything marked (Pro) above, from advanced POS, offline apps and multi store to expenses, manufacturing, CRM, HRM, repair, bookings, subscriptions, REST API, Report Builder and 60 reports.

External services
